# StreamDek Mobile — 12 August 2026

## Fixed

**Subtitle colours, background and bold now reach the player**
Text Colour, Background and Bold Text were saved and shown correctly in the preview, but
the player drew subtitles as if they had never been set — only Text Size and Vertical
Position had any effect. Colours are stored the way Android writes them, alpha first, and
both playback engines were reading those digits in the opposite order: yellow arrived as
a barely-there white, black text disappeared, and the Dimmed Black background was fully
transparent. On mpv two further things were in the way — a background panel was never
drawn at all, and a subtitle that carries its own styling (the ASS and SSA tracks common
in MKV files) ignored everything except sizing, which is why bold appeared to do nothing.
Your choices now override the subtitle's own styling, and a subtitle track is left as its
author styled it while you are still on the defaults.

**The subtitle preview follows the Vertical Position slider**
The sample line sat at the bottom of the preview whatever the slider said. It now moves
through the frame the way it will move over video, and slides off the bottom edge past
100 — the same as it would off the picture.

**Hero trailers play once**
A trailer on a title page started again on its own: scrolling the artwork out of view and
back restarted it, and a stream that faulted as it ran out sent it round a second time.
It now plays through once, then the artwork returns. The replay button on the artwork
starts it again whenever you want it.
